Subject: PO onboarding: confirm requirement set & itemization format

Hi Anita / BlueWave procurement team,

Thanks for moving this forward — excited to get BlueWave live. To make vendor onboarding and PO issuance smooth on both sides, can you confirm the exact PO requirements your AP team needs from Redwood? A few items we want to validate from our side: 

- Required fields on the PO: do you need SKU-level line items (unit price + qty + SKU) or is a single aggregate monthly charge acceptable for usage-based services?
- Tax handling: should tax be shown as a separate line item per SKU or as a single tax summary?
- GL / cost center codes: do you require a GL code on each line, or can one code be applied at the header level?
- Shipping/one-time setup fees: should these be listed separately or rolled into the first invoice?
- PO issuance timing: what is your typical turnaround once you receive the signed SOW/contract? We want to target a date that ensures May billing is captured if possible.

Attached are: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (example layout we typically send) and our Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf. If you have your preferred PO template or mandatory fields list, please share and we will align.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm PO required fields + timing.
2) Lauren will prepare the final PO wording and the accounting contact details.
3) We sign SOW via DocuSign (link included below) and route to your AP for issuance.

Target: PO issued by end of day 2027-05-18 to hit next billing window — is that feasible on your side?

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from BlueWave AP / procurement: 

- Line items: we prefer SKU-level line items for any fixed or committed charges (e.g., Dedicated pool commitments). For consumption-based items, an aggregated monthly line by product family is acceptable (example: "Hosted inference — model family A — May 2027 total").
- Required per line: description, unit price, quantity, and total. GL code is optional but helpful; if you can include it we will map on our end.
- Tax: show tax as a separate line per invoice (state/local tax) rather than repeating per SKU.
- Shipping/setup: list as separate line items when applicable.
- PO timeline: once we have signed SOW + vendor W-9, our standard process issues a PO within 7 business days. If the SOW is routed today, expect PO by 2027-05-20.

We also need your vendor tax classification and remit-to address on the PO. I will have our AP send a short onboarding checklist; I attached our internal vendor onboarding form (we'll fill it and return).

DocuSign: please send the SOW via DocuSign to anita.suresh@bluewave.com and procurement@bluewave.com.

- For committed Dedicated capacity, please itemize: SKU/instance type, term (e.g., 12-mo commit), monthly recurring fee, and any upfront setup fee as a separate line.

I will attach the Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx with example rows showing both (a) aggregated monthly consumption format and (b) committed capacity line-items for your review.

Thanks — quick technical note from billing/product so the PO aligns with how we generate invoices: 

For Hosted API (consumption):
- Recommended PO line structure: 
  * Product: "Redwood Hosted Inference — <model family>"
  * Description: "Monthly aggregate token consumption for <model family> (start-end date)"
  * Unit: "month"
  * Quantity: 1
  * Unit price: total monthly charge (USD)

This lets us issue one invoice line per model family per month. If BlueWave wants further breakout (e.g., per-environment dev/prod), we can do that but it increases reconciliation complexity.

For Dedicated / Committed Capacity:
- Required PO lines: 
  * SKU (e.g., RDW-DED-GPU-a100-8x)
  * Description: instance type, number of GPUs/CPUs, region, term (12/24 mo)
  * Quantity: number of instances/pools
  * Unit price: monthly recurring charge per instance/pool
  * One-time setup fee: separate line if applicable

Misc notes: 
- Taxes: we show taxes as a single summary line on invoices (we can also break it out per state if required).
- GL codes: include a GL column in your PO if available; otherwise we will reconcile header-level GL.
- Remit-to: Redwood Payments LLC, 120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103 (include EIN on PO).

Recommended final line-item templates (copy these to your PO):
- For consumption: "Redwood Hosted Inference — ModelFamilyA | Monthly aggregate token charge | month | 1 | $12,345.67"
- For committed: "RDW-DED-GPU-a100-8x | Dedicated pool (8x A100) — us-west | month | 2 | $45,000.00"

Confluence with examples: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROC/PO+Line+Item+Examples

Next steps: Lauren to populate the PO template with BlueWave preferred product names; Marcus to review and route the SOW via DocuSign once the template is final. Anita — if 2027-05-20 is still OK for PO issuance, we'll plan to sync timing to the May billing window.
